findings.reason: Constructor, beforeRequest, onSuccess/onFailure, defaultReadyToTrip and Execute support sequence.
Counts omits currentState; State, beforeRequest and afterRequest check expiry and generation before effects.
beforeRequest and onSuccess/onFailure plus half-open expiry state support admission and abandonment ordering.
Allow has no per-admission completion guard; onSuccess closes after the second report.
Execute defer and afterRequest support non-nil and legacy recover-nil paths; Go runtime setting qualification explicitly OPEN.
State/onFailure hold mutex and setState invokes callback synchronously; State and Counts reacquire it.
